content.title: 现在完成进行时 have/has been doing 速查
content.intro: 结构:have/has + been + 动词-ing。意义:某动作从过去某时开始、一直持续到现在(可能刚停、也可能还在继续),常强调'持续了多久'或'一直在做'。判断口诀:看到 for / since + 时间,且动作是持续性的、延续到此刻,就用 have/has been doing。

rows: 强调持续过程:They have been using these passages for years.(一直在用)
强调结果/完成:They have built 33 passages.(已建成,看数量结果)
只表此刻:Look! An antelope is crossing now.(就在此刻)
for + 时间段 / since + 起点 / all day / how long / 现在可见的结果(累、湿、脏)

specialRules.rule: for/since + 一段时间 + 持续动作 → 用 have/has been doing,不用现在进行时
specialRules.mark: I have been waiting for two hours.(× I am waiting for two hours.)

specialRules.rule: 现在可见的状态/结果由持续动作造成 → 用进行式强调过程
specialRules.mark: Your boots are muddy. You have been walking in the wetland.(强调一直在走)

specialRules.rule: 强调'已完成/做了多少' → 用现在完成时(done),不用进行式
specialRules.mark: I have planted ten trees.(数量结果,不用 have been planting ten trees)

specialRules.rule: 主语单复数决定 have/has;been 不变
specialRules.mark: He has been working / They have been working

why: 现在完成进行时把'过去开始'(完成体)和'持续进行'(进行体)合在一起,所以它既连接到现在,又突出动作一直没停;而现在完成时(have done)更看重那个'结果',现在进行时(am doing)只锁定'此刻'。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空给出动词原形 + for/since/all day 标记 → 多半填 have/has been doing;注意主谓一致(has/have)。
完成进行 vs 完成:有明确数量或 already/just/yet 看结果用 done;问 how long、强调过程用 been doing。
完成进行 vs 进行:带 for/since 用 been doing,只带 now/at the moment 用 am/is/are doing。

examVsReal.exam: I have been studying English for six years.(考试规范)
examVsReal.real: I've been studying English for six years.
examVsReal.note: 口语里 have/has 常缩写成 've/'s;意义不变。

examVsReal.exam: It has been raining since this morning.(考试)
examVsReal.note: 真实英语里 all morning 与 since this morning 可互换,都表持续到现在。
